theorems.name: Submission.dimred_cs_psd_ball_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (L : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (μ μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)), μ₀ (Lᗮ : Set (Euclid P))ᶜ = 0 → (∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → μ A = ∫⁻ t in (L : Set (Euclid P)), μ₀ ((fun y => t + y) ⁻¹' A) ∂μHE[Module.finrank ℝ L]) → ∀ t ∈ L, ∀ y ∈ Lᗮ, ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → μ (ball (t + y) ρ) = ∫⁻ σ : Euclid (Module.finrank ℝ L), μ₀ (ball y (Real.sqrt (ρ ^ 2 - ‖σ‖ ^ 2)))
